{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())
print(df['customer_segment'].value_counts())
print(df['channel'].value_counts())
print(df['status'].value_counts())
print(df['converted'].value_counts())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check revenue format
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for QA orders
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == 999999.99: {(df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {(df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()}")

# Check if any 'new' customers were reached by 'paid_search'
print(f"Number of 'new' customers in 'paid_search' channel: {(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')}.sum()")"}
